meta.name: Material 3 Expressive Desktop Design System for Quickshell

matugen.verifiedAgainst: matugen 4.2.0 sources (material-colors 0.4.0): CLI args, config struct, template keywords, custom colours, JSON output
matugen.roleBreakdown: 47 M3 scheme roles (matugen emits 49; deprecated background/onBackground skipped) + 8 harmonized status roles (success, warning)
matugen.generator: Palettes below were generated with Material Color Utilities 0.3.0 (2021 spec), the algorithm matugen ports; parity verified with matugen's own unit test (scheme-content, #FF0000, dark primary #FFB4A8)

marginPx.note: Screen-axis margins; edgeGap/endGap are derived per bar orientation

guardrails.securityFallback: privacy/recording indicators float on WlrLayer.Overlay when no bar on the screen hosts them

reducedMotion.effect: Spatial Behaviors disabled, decorative loops stopped, effects collapse to a 100ms crossfade

reducedTransparency.effect: Every surface tier renders at 100% alpha; compositor blur disabled

highContrast.effect: Opaque tiers, full-strength outline borders, 3px focus ring

confirmByHold.effect: Destructive actions confirm by holding the pointer or key for 2s; false switches to press-twice confirmation

expressiveSprings.effect: false makes every spatial spring critically damped (damping 1.0): motion stays, overshoot goes

keyboardModality.effect: Focus ring visible only after Tab/arrow navigation; cleared by pointer press

springFastSpatial.usage: Button press squish, workspace pill width morph, switch thumb slide, slider thumb gap morph

springDefaultSpatial.usage: Bar widget pill-to-popover shared container morph, Control Center sub-sheet unfold, apps-widget icon hover lift (single icon, no neighbor displacement)

springSlowSpatial.usage: Workspace Overview zoom, Lock Screen clock entrance, Wallpaper carousel slide

springFastEffects.usage: Hover (8%) and Press (12%) state layer alpha, focus ring opacity

springDefaultEffects.usage: Dynamic color palette crossfades, modal scrim opacity, surface mode transitions

holdToConfirm.easing: linear (time made visible); never shortened by Reduced Motion

reducedMotion.decorativeLoops: stopped (polygon rotation, seekbar wave, pulses, bounces, shutter flash)

sampler.lobedFormula: r = 1 - depth + depth * u^sharpness, u = (1 + cos(lobes * (theta + PI/2))) / 2
sampler.morph: r_final = r * (1 - progress) + progress (0.35 hover, 1.0 pressed)
sampler.contentRule: Content stays inside a centered circle of diameter itemWidth * 0.92 * safeContentRatio

scallop_12.allowedUsage: Media prev/next buttons, weather badge, battery ring, Widget Peek trigger, analog clock dial

clover_4.allowedUsage: Album art mask, primary play/pause, lock screen avatar frame

flower_8.allowedUsage: Date hero badge, petal media hero ring, accent status badge

hexagon.allowedUsage: Editorial serif clock tile, Polkit security shield, events desktop widget

diamond.allowedUsage: CPU/RAM telemetry desktop gauges (short numeric values only)

rounded_triangle.allowedUsage: Icon-only badges (AI / search launcher sparkle); never text or inputs

slanted_pill.allowedUsage: Expressive tag, desktop greeting and date pill (single short label)

typography.textScaleMultiplier: Every sizePx and lineHeightPx is multiplied by Tokens.textScale (1.0 | 1.15 | 1.3)

pointerTargetsPx.edgeHitExtension: Bar hit areas extend through the screen margin to the physical screen edge
